__comment_initialize__: The client sends an initialize request to negotiate capabilities and protocol version.
__comment_initialize_response__: The server responds with its capabilities, confirming it provides tools.
__comment_tools_list__: The client queries the server for the list of available tools.
__comment_tools_list_response__: The server returns the tool schema. Model is NOT called here.

tools.name: get_employee_record
tools.description: Look up an employee's grade band and accrued leave balance by employee ID.

__comment_tools_call__: The client executes the tool with arguments generated by the model. The Model Call happens exactly BEFORE this step on the host side, where the LLM reasons to use the tool.
__comment_tools_call_response__: The server executes the tool locally and returns the result back to the client. Model is NOT called here.
